requirements.title: Human Oversight
requirements.description: High-risk AI systems shall be designed and developed in such a way that they can be effectively overseen by natural persons.

requirements.title: Accuracy, Robustness and Cybersecurity
requirements.description: High-risk AI systems shall be designed to achieve an appropriate level of accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity.

requirements.title: Risk Management Governance
requirements.description: Roles and responsibilities of personnel involved in the design, development, and use of AI systems are documented.

requirements.title: AI System Life Cycle
requirements.description: Establish and maintain a record of the AI system life cycle for traceability.

requirements.title: Logical Access
requirements.description: The entity restricts logical access to confidential information and assets to authorized users.
